diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default explicitly depends on :resource.time_sleep.wait_for_aws_s3_bucket_settings, but that ordering is already enforced transitively through :resource.aws_s3_bucket_ownership_controls.origin, which depends on the same sleep resource. Remove the direct sleep dependency while retaining the ownership-controls dependency.

:resource.time_sleep.wait_for_aws_s3_bucket_settings explicitly depends on :resource.aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.origin, but its dependency on :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.default already enforces that ordering because the policy depends on the public-access block. Remove the direct public-access-block dependency while retaining the policy dependency.
